verses.original: וּמִן־ הַתְּכֵ֤לֶת וְהָֽאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת הַשָּׁנִ֔י עָשׂ֥וּ בִגְדֵי־ שְׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hat·tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·hā·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ haš·šā·nî ‘ā·śū ḇiḡ·ḏê- śə·rāḏ lə·šā·rêṯ baq·qō·ḏeš way·ya·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê haq·qō·ḏeš ’ă·šer lə·’a·hă·rōn ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: From the blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . they made specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary . . . as well as the holy garments for Aaron just as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: FIZERAM também as vestes do ministério, para ministrar no santuário, de azul, e de púrpura e de carmesim; também fizeram as vestes santas, para Arão, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ zā·hāḇ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār
verses.literal: Bezalel made the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold and with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim se fez o éfode de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim e de linho fino torcido.

verses.original: וַֽיְרַקְּע֞וּ אֶת־ פַּחֵ֣י הַזָּהָב֮ וְקִצֵּ֣ץ פְּתִילִם֒ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת בְּת֤וֹךְ הַתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וּבְת֣וֹךְ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּבְת֛וֹךְ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וּבְת֣וֹךְ הַשֵּׁ֑שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: way·raq·qə·‘ū ’eṯ- pa·ḥê haz·zā·hāḇ wə·qiṣ·ṣêṣ pə·ṯî·lim la·‘ă·śō·wṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ hat·tə·ḵê·leṯ ū·ḇə·ṯō·wḵ hā·’ar·gā·mān ū·ḇə·ṯō·wḵ tō·w·la·‘aṯ haš·šā·nî ū·ḇə·ṯō·wḵ haš·šêš ma·‘ă·śêh ḥō·šêḇ
verses.literal: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut threads from them to interweave . . . with the blue . . . purple . . . and scarlet yarn . . . . . . and fine linen the work of a skilled craftsman
verses.literalPt: E estenderam as lâminas de ouro, e as cortaram em fios, para tecê-los entre o azul, e entre a púrpura, e entre o carmesim, e entre o linho fino com trabalho esmerado.

verses.original: כְּתֵפֹ֥ת עָֽשׂוּ־ ל֖וֹ חֹבְרֹ֑ת עַל־ שְׁנֵ֥י קִצְווֹתוֹ חֻבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṯê·p̄ōṯ ‘ā·śū- lōw ḥō·ḇə·rōṯ ‘al- šə·nê qiṣ·wō·ṯō ḥub·bār
verses.literal: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod which were attached at two of its corners so it could be fastened
verses.literalPt: Fizeram-lhe ombreiras que se ajuntavam; e uniam-se em suas duas pontas.

verses.original: וְחֵ֨שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּת֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֗יו מִמֶּ֣נּוּ הוּא֮ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ֒ זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥê·šeḇ ’ă·p̄ud·dā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāw mim·men·nū hū kə·ma·‘ă·śê·hū zā·hāḇ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod was of one piece with the ephod of the same workmanship with gold with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and with finely spun linen just as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: E o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode, que estava sobre ele, formava com ele uma só peça e era de obra semelhante, de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם מֻֽסַבֹּ֖ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב מְפֻתָּחֹת֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם עַל־ שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- ’aḇ·nê haš·šō·ham mu·sab·bōṯ miš·bə·ṣōṯ zā·hāḇ mə·p̄ut·tā·ḥōṯ pit·tū·ḥê ḥō·w·ṯām ‘al- šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: They mounted the onyx . . . stones in gold filigree settings engraved . . . like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel
verses.literalPt: Também prepararam as pedras de ônix, engastadas em ouro, lavradas com gravuras de um selo, com os nomes dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֗ם עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּר֖וֹן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’ō·ṯām ‘al kiṯ·p̄ōṯ hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ ’aḇ·nê zik·kā·rō·wn liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: E as pôs sobre as ombreiras do éfode por pedras de memória para os filhos de Israel, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת־ הַחֹ֛שֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·šen ma·‘ă·śêh ḥō·šêḇ kə·ma·‘ă·śêh ’ê·p̄ōḏ zā·hāḇ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār
verses.literal: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship . . . . . . as the ephod with gold with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and with finely spun linen
verses.literalPt: Fez-se também o peitoral de obra de artífice, como a obra do éfode, de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido.

verses.original: רָב֧וּעַ הָיָ֛ה כָּפ֖וּל עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת־ הַחֹ֑שֶׁן זֶ֧רֶת אָרְכּ֛וֹ וְזֶ֥רֶת רָחְבּ֖וֹ כָּפֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: rā·ḇū·a‘ hā·yāh kā·p̄ūl ‘ā·śū ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·šen ze·reṯ ’ā·rə·kōw wə·ze·reṯ rā·ḥə·bōw kā·p̄ūl
verses.literal: It - was square . . . when folded over double a span long and a span wide . . .
verses.literalPt: Quadrado era; duplo fizeram o peitoral; o seu comprimento era de um palmo, e a sua largura de um palmo dobrado.

verses.original: וַיְמַלְאוּ־ ב֔וֹ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה ט֣וּרֵי אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·mal·’ū- ḇōw ’ar·bā·‘āh ṭū·rê ’ā·ḇen ṭūr ’ō·ḏem piṭ·ḏāh ū·ḇā·re·qeṯ haṭ·ṭūr hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: And they mounted on it four rows of gemstones The first row had . . . a ruby a topaz and an emerald
verses.literalPt: E engastaram nele quatro ordens de pedras; uma ordem de um sárdio, de um topázio, e de um carbúnculo; esta era a primeira ordem;

verses.original: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṭ·ṭūr haš·šê·nî nō·p̄eḵ sap·pîr wə·yā·hă·lōm
verses.literal: the second row had a turquoise a sapphire and a diamond
verses.literalPt: E a segunda ordem de uma esmeralda, de uma safira e de um diamante;

verses.original: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṭ·ṭūr haš·šə·lî·šî le·šem šə·ḇōw wə·’aḥ·lā·māh
verses.literal: the third row had a jacinth an agate and an amethyst
verses.literalPt: E a terceira ordem de um jacinto, de uma ágata, e de uma ametista;

verses.original: וְהַטּוּר֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מֽוּסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṭ·ṭūr hā·rə·ḇî·‘î tar·šîš šō·ham wə·yā·šə·p̄êh mū·sab·bōṯ miš·bə·ṣō·wṯ zā·hāḇ bə·mil·lu·’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: and the fourth row had a beryl an onyx and a jasper These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings
verses.literalPt: E a quarta ordem de um berilo, e de um ônix, e de um jaspe, engastadas em engastes de ouro.

verses.original: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִים עַל־ שְׁמֹ֨ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הֵ֛נָּה שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־ שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־ שְׁמ֔וֹ לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ‘al- šə·mōṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl hên·nāh šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ‘al- šə·mō·ṯām pit·tū·ḥê ḥō·ṯām ’îš ‘al- šə·mōw liš·nêm ‘ā·śār šā·ḇeṭ
verses.literal: The twelve . . . . . . stones corresponded to the names . . . of the sons of Israel Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve . . . tribes
verses.literalPt: Estas pedras, pois, eram segundo os nomes dos filhos de Israel, doze segundo os seus nomes; como gravuras de selo, cada uma com o seu nome, segundo as doze tribos.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ עַל־ הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ‘al- ha·ḥō·šen šar·šə·rōṯ gaḇ·luṯ ma·‘ă·śêh ‘ă·ḇōṯ zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr
verses.literal: For the breastpiece they made braided chains like cords . . . of pure gold
verses.literalPt: Também fizeram para o peitoral cadeiazinhas de igual medida, obra de ouro puro trançado.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וּשְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū šə·tê miš·bə·ṣōṯ zā·hāḇ ū·šə·tê ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ zā·hāḇ way·yit·tə·nū ’eṯ- šə·tê haṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ōṯ ‘al- šə·nê qə·ṣō·wṯ ha·ḥō·šen
verses.literal: They also made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings and fastened the two rings to the two corners of the breastpiece
verses.literalPt: E fizeram dois engastes de ouro e duas argolas de ouro; e puseram as duas argolas nas duas extremidades do peitoral.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ הָעֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת עַל־ קְצ֖וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū šə·tê hā·‘ă·ḇō·ṯōṯ haz·zā·hāḇ ‘al- šə·tê haṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ōṯ ‘al- qə·ṣō·wṯ ha·ḥō·šen
verses.literal: Then they fastened the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece
verses.literalPt: E puseram as duas cadeiazinhas de trança de ouro nas duas argolas, nas duas extremidades do peitoral.

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָֽעֲבֹתֹ֔ת נָתְנ֖וּ עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹ֑ת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֛ם עַל־ כִּתְפֹ֥ת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל־ מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šə·tê qə·ṣō·wṯ šə·tê hā·‘ă·ḇō·ṯōṯ nā·ṯə·nū ‘al- šə·tê ham·miš·bə·ṣōṯ way·yit·tə·num ‘al- kiṯ·p̄ōṯ hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ ’el- mūl pā·nāw
verses.literal: and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front . . .
verses.literalPt: E as outras duas pontas das duas cadeiazinhas de trança puseram nos dois engastes; e as puseram sobre as ombreiras do éfode na frente dele.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וַיָּשִׂ֕ימוּ עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל־ שְׂפָת֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל־ עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū šə·tê ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ zā·hāḇ way·yā·śî·mū ‘al- šə·nê qə·ṣō·wṯ ha·ḥō·šen ‘al- śə·p̄ā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ’el- ‘ê·ḇer hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ bā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on . . . the inside edge next to the ephod
verses.literalPt: Fizeram também duas argolas de ouro, que puseram nas duas extremidades do peitoral, na sua borda que estava junto ao éfode por dentro.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָב֒ וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֡ם עַל־ שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֤ד מִלְמַ֙טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתּ֑וֹ מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū šə·tê ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ zā·hāḇ way·yit·tə·num ‘al- šə·tê ḵiṯ·p̄ōṯ hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ mil·maṭ·ṭāh mim·mūl pā·nāw lə·‘um·maṯ meḥ·bar·tōw mim·ma·‘al lə·ḥê·šeḇ hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ
verses.literal: They made two additional gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod on its front . . . near the seam just above its woven waistband . . .
verses.literalPt: Fizeram mais duas argolas de ouro, que puseram nas duas ombreiras do éfode, abaixo, na frente dele, perto da sua juntura, sobre o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode.

verses.original: וַיִּרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־ הַחֹ֡שֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָיו֩ אֶל־ טַבְּעֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֜ד בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֗לֶת לִֽהְיֹת֙ עַל־ חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְלֹֽא־ יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·kə·sū ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·šen miṭ·ṭab·bə·‘ō·ṯāw ’el- ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ bip̄·ṯîl tə·ḵê·leṯ lih·yōṯ ‘al- ḥê·šeḇ hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ wə·lō- yiz·zaḥ ha·ḥō·šen mê·‘al hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Then they tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod just as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: E ligaram o peitoral com as suas argolas às argolas do éfode com um cordão de azul, para que estivesse sobre o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode, e o peitoral não se separasse do éfode, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־ מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפֹ֖ד מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג כְּלִ֖יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- mə·‘îl hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ ma·‘ă·śêh ’ō·rêḡ kə·lîl tə·ḵê·leṯ
verses.literal: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth the work of a weaver
verses.literalPt: E fez-se o manto do éfode de obra tecida, todo de azul.

verses.original: וּפִֽי־ הַמְּעִ֥יל בְּתוֹכ֖וֹ כְּפִ֣י תַחְרָ֑א שָׂפָ֥ה לְפִ֛יו סָבִ֖יב לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄î- ham·mə·‘îl bə·ṯō·w·ḵōw kə·p̄î ṯaḥ·rā śā·p̄āh lə·p̄îw sā·ḇîḇ lō yiq·qā·rê·a‘
verses.literal: with an opening in the center of the robe like that of a garment with a collar around the opening so that it would not tear
verses.literalPt: E a abertura do manto estava no meio dele, como abertura de cota de malha; esta abertura tinha uma borda em volta, para que se não rompesse.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עַל־ שׁוּלֵ֣י הַמְּעִ֔יל רִמּוֹנֵ֕י תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֑י מָשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ‘al- šū·lê ham·mə·‘îl rim·mō·w·nê tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî mā·šə·zār
verses.literal: They made pomegranates of blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe
verses.literalPt: E nas bordas do manto fizeram romãs de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, de fio torcido.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ פַעֲמֹנֵ֖י זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת־ הַפַּֽעֲמֹנִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִ֗ים עַל־ שׁוּלֵ֤י הַמְּעִיל֙ סָבִ֔יב בְּת֖וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū p̄a·‘ă·mō·nê zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr way·yit·tə·nū ’eṯ- hap·pa·‘ă·mō·nîm bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·rim·mō·nîm ‘al- šū·lê ham·mə·‘îl sā·ḇîḇ bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·rim·mō·nîm
verses.literal: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them - around the hem between the pomegranates
verses.literalPt: Fizeram também as campainhas de ouro puro, pondo as campainhas no meio das romãs nas bordas do manto, ao redor, entre as romãs;

verses.original: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן וְרִמֹּן֙ פַּעֲמֹ֣ן וְרִמֹּ֔ן עַל־ שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִ֑יב לְשָׁרֵ֕ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: pa·‘ă·mōn wə·rim·mōn pa·‘ă·mōn wə·rim·mōn ‘al- šū·lê ham·mə·‘îl sā·ḇîḇ lə·šā·rêṯ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: alternating the bells and pomegranates . . . . . . . . . around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry just as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Uma campainha e uma romã, outra campainha e outra romã, nas bordas do manto ao redor; para ministrar, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־ הַכָּתְנֹ֥ת שֵׁ֖שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- hak·kā·ṯə·nōṯ šêš ma·‘ă·śêh ’ō·rêḡ lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw
verses.literal: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen the work of a weaver
verses.literalPt: Fizeram também as túnicas de linho fino, de obra tecida, para Arão e para seus filhos.

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ הַמִּצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְאֶת־ פַּאֲרֵ֥י הַמִּגְבָּעֹ֖ת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאֶת־ מִכְנְסֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ham·miṣ·ne·p̄eṯ šêš wə·’eṯ- pa·’ă·rê ham·miḡ·bā·‘ōṯ šêš wə·’eṯ- miḵ·nə·sê hab·bāḏ šêš mā·šə·zār
verses.literal: as well as the turban of fine linen the ornate headbands . . . and undergarments . . . of finely spun linen
verses.literalPt: E a mitra de linho fino, e o ornato das tiaras de linho fino, e os calções de linho fino torcido,

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ הָאַבְנֵ֞ט שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’aḇ·nêṭ šêš mā·šə·zār ū·ṯə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî ma·‘ă·śêh rō·qêm ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: and the sash of finely spun linen embroidered with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . just as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: E o cinto de linho fino torcido, e de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, obra de bordador, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־ צִ֥יץ נֵֽזֶר־ הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּכְתְּב֣וּ עָלָ֗יו מִכְתַּב֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- ṣîṣ nê·zer- haq·qō·ḏeš zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr way·yiḵ·tə·ḇū ‘ā·lāw miḵ·taḇ pit·tū·ḥê ḥō·w·ṯām qō·ḏeš Yah·weh
verses.literal: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold and they engraved on it like an inscription . . . on a seal HOLY TO THE LORD
verses.literalPt: Fizeram também, de ouro puro, a lâmina da coroa de santidade, e nela escreveram o escrito como de gravura de selo: SANTIDADE AO SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָיו֙ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לָתֵ֥ת עַל־ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū ‘ā·lāw pə·ṯîl tə·ḵê·leṯ lā·ṯêṯ ‘al- ham·miṣ·ne·p̄eṯ mil·mā·‘ə·lāh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban . . . just as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: E ataram-na com um cordão de azul, para prendê-la à parte superior da mitra, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֕כֶל כָּל־ עֲבֹדַ֕ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·ḵel kāl- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ miš·kan ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ way·ya·‘ă·śū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh kên ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: So all the work for the tabernacle the Tent of Meeting was completed The Israelites . . . did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim se acabou toda a obra do tabernáculo da tenda da congregação; e os filhos de Israel fizeram conforme a tudo o que o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés; assim o fizeram.

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֤יאוּ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ הָאֹ֖הֶל וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו קְרָסָ֣יו קְרָשָׁ֔יו בְּרִיחוֹ וְעַמֻּדָ֥יו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān ’el- mō·šeh ’eṯ- hā·’ō·hel wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw qə·rā·sāw qə·rā·šāw bə·rī·ḥō wə·‘am·mu·ḏāw wa·’ă·ḏā·nāw
verses.literal: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses the tent with all its furnishings its clasps its frames its crossbars and its posts and bases
verses.literalPt: Depois trouxeram a Moisés o tabernáculo, a tenda e todos os seus pertences; os seus colchetes, as suas tábuas, os seus varais, e as suas colunas, e as suas bases;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מִכְסֵ֞ה עוֹרֹ֤ת הָֽאֵילִם֙ הַמְאָדָּמִ֔ים וְאֶת־ מִכְסֵ֖ה עֹרֹ֣ת הַתְּחָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- miḵ·sêh ‘ō·w·rōṯ hā·’ê·lim ham·’ād·dā·mîm wə·’eṯ- miḵ·sêh ‘ō·rōṯ hat·tə·ḥā·šîm wə·’êṯ pā·rō·ḵeṯ ham·mā·sāḵ
verses.literal: the covering of ram skins dyed red the covering of fine leather and the veil of the covering
verses.literalPt: E a cobertura de peles de carneiro tintas de vermelho, e a cobertura de peles de texugos, e o véu de cobertura;

verses.original: אֶת־ אֲרֹ֥ן הָעֵדֻ֖ת וְאֶת־ בַּדָּ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ’ă·rōn hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ wə·’eṯ- bad·dāw wə·’êṯ hak·kap·pō·reṯ
verses.literal: the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the mercy seat
verses.literalPt: A arca do testemunho, e os seus varais, e o propiciatório;

verses.original: אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān ’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw wə·’êṯ le·ḥem hap·pā·nîm
verses.literal: the table with all its utensils and the Bread of the Presence
verses.literalPt: A mesa com todos os seus pertences, e os pães da proposição;

verses.original: אֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָ֨ה הַטְּהֹרָ֜ה אֶת־ נֵרֹתֶ֗יהָ נֵרֹ֛ת הַמַּֽעֲרָכָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ham·mə·nō·rāh haṭ·ṭə·hō·rāh ’eṯ- nê·rō·ṯe·hā nê·rōṯ ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·le·hā wə·’êṯ še·men ham·mā·’ō·wr
verses.literal: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps . . . . . . and all its utensils as well as the oil for the light
verses.literalPt: O candelabro puro com suas lâmpadas, as lâmpadas em ordem, e todos os seus pertences, e o azeite para a luminária;

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ miz·baḥ haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’êṯ še·men ham·miš·ḥāh wə·’êṯ qə·ṭō·reṯ has·sam·mîm wə·’êṯ mā·saḵ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: the gold altar the anointing oil the fragrant incense and the curtain for the entrance to the tent
verses.literalPt: Também o altar de ouro, e o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático, e a cortina da porta da tenda;

verses.original: אֵ֣ת׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת וְאֶת־ מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ אֶת־ בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־ כַּנּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ miz·baḥ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·’eṯ- miḵ·bar han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer- lōw ’eṯ- bad·dāw wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw ’eṯ- hak·kî·yōr wə·’eṯ- kan·nōw
verses.literal: the bronze altar with its bronze - grating its poles and all its utensils the basin with its stand
verses.literalPt: O altar de cobre, e o seu crivo de cobre, os seus varais, e todos os seus pertences, a pia, e a sua base;

verses.original: אֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֶת־ עַמֻּדֶ֣יהָ וְאֶת־ אֲדָנֶ֗יהָ וְאֶת־ הַמָּסָךְ֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֶת־ מֵיתָרָ֖יו וִיתֵדֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֗ת כָּל־ כְּלֵ֛י עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ qal·‘ê he·ḥā·ṣêr ’eṯ- ‘am·mu·ḏe·hā wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḏā·ne·hā wə·’eṯ- ham·mā·sāḵ lə·ša·‘ar he·ḥā·ṣêr ’eṯ- mê·ṯā·rāw wî·ṯê·ḏō·ṯe·hā wə·’êṯ kāl- kə·lê ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ham·miš·kān lə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases the curtain for the gate of the courtyard its ropes and tent pegs and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: As cortinas do pátio, as suas colunas, e as suas bases, e a cortina da porta do pátio, as suas cordas, e os seus pregos, e todos os utensílios do serviço do tabernáculo, para a tenda da congregação;

verses.original: אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê haś·śə·rāḏ lə·šā·rêṯ baq·qō·ḏeš ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê haq·qō·ḏeš lə·’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên wə·’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê ḇā·nāw lə·ḵa·hên
verses.literal: and the woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests
verses.literalPt: As vestes do ministério para ministrar no santuário; as santas vestes de Arão o sacerdote, e as vestes dos seus filhos, para administrarem o sacerdócio.

verses.original: כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֤ן עָשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כָּל־ הָעֲבֹדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh kên ‘ā·śū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’êṯ kāl- hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Conforme a tudo o que o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés, assim fizeram os filhos de Israel toda a obra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨רְא מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה וְהִנֵּה֙ עָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה כֵּ֣ן עָשׂ֑וּ וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֹתָ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yar mō·šeh ’eṯ- kāl- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh wə·hin·nêh ‘ā·śū ’ō·ṯāh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh kên ‘ā·śū way·ḇā·reḵ ’ō·ṯām mō·šeh
verses.literal: And Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had accomplished it just as the LORD . . . had commanded So Moses blessed them
verses.literalPt: Viu, pois, Moisés toda a obra, e eis que a tinham feito; como o SENHOR ordenara, assim a fizeram; então Moisés os abençoou.
